tax-calc.usage: Enter your gross monthly salary, month of the year and deductions. The tool applies the cumulative withholding method exactly as the tax authority does: taxable income accumulates from January, is matched against the withholding rate table, and the tax already withheld in previous months is subtracted. tips: Under cumulative withholding, early months are taxed at lower rates and later months at higher ones — the 12 months sum exactly to the annual tax
Annual bonus can be taxed separately or merged into comprehensive income; compute both and pick the lower total
Deductions accumulate only from the month they actually start — a child born in September should not trigger deductions for January-August
